description:
This specific requirement for CSPs to enable AIC key management is absent in ISO 42001, which does not address CSP-AIC relationships or key management autonomy.
Add a control requiring Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) supporting AI systems to provide AI Customers (AICs) with the capability to manage their own data encryption keys, addressing the gap in ISO 42001:2023, which lacks specific provisions for CSP-AIC key management responsibilities. This enhances general cryptographic controls (e.g., ISO 27001 A.8.24, ISO 27002 8.24) by explicitly mandating CSP support for AIC key autonomy, including implementation guidance and compliance verification.
